page.layout: One page of running text, no margin notes. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: dicat: Deus ubi in maiestate sua nouissimo die aduene-rit, tam seuerum atq; horrendum exercebit in impios iudicium, ut omnia elementa ad id contremiscere, sol & luna commoueri, sancti uero tantam potentiam, iu-sticiam & gloriam admirari, suspicere, prædicare debeant. Non admodum ab his dissident, quæ de seueritā-te Diuini iudicij leguntur Luc.21. Matth.24. In summa igitur illud omnibus hisce confit, hæcq; obseruatio septima colligitur: Impios nunquam posse manus Domini euadere: etsi interdum differuntur pœnæ, nequaquam tamen in totum remittuntur, sed breui sine dubio infligentur: aut si cui uideatur hic plane remitti, argumentum est, post hanc uitam sequuturas multo atrociores: plerosque uero pariter in hac uita & post hanc uitam acerbissimas pœnas pendere. Qua in re imprimis iustitia Dei & seueritas, deinde potetia eiusdem elucescut. Respicit autem propheta hic ad ea quæ de internetione impiorum passim & singulis fere capitibus antecedentibus dicta sunt. Vtile uero est non solum impijs, uerum etiā pijs, longiore oratione hanc caussam de damnatione impiorum peragi. Nūquam enim satis operose potest discuti, quod ad timorem Dei, qui est primus ad salutem & sapientiam spiritualem gradus, inducēdum confert. Atq; hic iam potes ammodo aduertere, initio præsentis loci recte à nobis dictum, nihil aliud tota hac concione prophetam uelle, quàm inuitare pios omnes, ut in uaticinijs de tot gētium miserabili uastatione an-tecedēt-

page.notes: Printed text is in one column. The long s is printed as a letter resembling f in several words (e.g. "feuerum", "fufpicere", "fticiam"); these are read as s. Line-end hyphenation "feueritā-/te" and "antecedēt-" (catchword "tecedeN-") are reproduced as printed; the abbreviation for -ta- at line 5 is uncertain. Possible [?] readings were not marked because the scan is legible enough at this resolution.
